Package de.nexus.antixray.api.event

package de.nexus.antixray.api.event
The Bukkit events NexusAntiXRay calls.

They are ordinary Bukkit events: register a Listener as for any other event. All of them are synchronous. The events about a player are called on the thread that ticks that player (the server thread, on Folia the region thread that owns the player). Events without a player, such as ThrottleLevelChangeEvent, are called on the server thread, on Folia on the global region thread. None is called from a network or ray tracing thread. The documentation of each event says from which situation it is called.

The constructors are public because Bukkit events are plain classes. They are meant for NexusAntiXRay; an event created and called by another plugin has no effect on NexusAntiXRay.

Since:
1.0.0
